name: Tuas Water Reclamation Park, Singapore
description: Singapore's next-generation co-located water-reclamation and energy facility under DTSS Phase 2: used water from the deep tunnel is treated at Tuas with an integrated used-water treatment, NEWater production and biogas energy recovery complex; designed with membrane bioreactors and up to ~2 MW-scale solar on site. PUB positions Tuas WRP as the world's most energy-efficient WRP concept (pre-cooling of digesters, co-location with IWMF waste-to-energy).

milestones.event: DTSS Phase 2 civil works advancing (Tuas tunnel and plant construction)
